THE WEDSPARKS GUIDE

How to Build Your Wedding-Day Timeline

A good timeline gives the day structure without filling every moment.

Start your wedding planExplore suppliers

By WedSparks · Wedding planning guide

01

Anchor the ceremony and meal

Start with ceremony time, venue access, reception start and meal service. Confirm the fixed points with the people responsible for them.

02

Work backwards through preparation

Ask hair, makeup and photography suppliers what time they need. Allow space for getting dressed, travel and a quiet moment before the ceremony.

03

Plan the transitions

Moving guests, organising photographs and changing rooms take time. Think about who will guide people and what happens while the couple is away for photos.

04

Share the practical version

Include locations and key contacts in the working run sheet. Share only the details each person needs, and keep one current version as plans change.

05

Make the template your own

The public timeline builder is a flexible starting point. Adjust it for your ceremony style, cultural celebrations, venue rules and what you want to enjoy.
